This helps frame an interpretive question raised by the passage: Acts portrays Paul unable to see, led by others, fasting three days, visited and touched by Ananias, regaining sight, receiving baptism and food, and entering mission. Treats dependency and care as part of the call narrative without requiring cure before vocation or identifying the event as Paul's thorn.
